root_cause.text: tb_xdomain_copy() unconditionally copies the expected response size from the received packet buffer without verifying that the actual frame size is at least that large, allowing an out-of-bounds read into stale DMA pool data when a short response arrives.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description states: "tb_xdomain_copy() copies req->response_size bytes from the received packet buffer regardless of the actual frame size. When a short response arrives, this reads past the valid frame data in the DMA pool buffer into stale contents from previous transactions." The fix uses `min_t(size_t, pkg->frame.size, req->response_size)` to limit the copy length.
